clock.name: bell_attention
clock.at_max: Fog thickens and adds a 10-minute travel detour; safe Reedwater path remains available. Does not close exits.

scenes.player_prompt: A mapmaker has gone missing. The keeper offers pay for proof of the changing road.
essential_clues: The surveyor Elowen Rusk left for the old tollhouse at dusk.
The road can be approached by the north gate or reed track.

scenes.player_prompt: Four maps of the same stretch of road disagree by exactly one mile.
essential_clues: Older surveys show an unmarked stone near the flooded route.
A sketch notes a phrase: 'A road is kept by those who return.'
optional_clues: Lio Quill moved an iron marker and feels responsible.
A map scrap is useful for redirecting the bell.

scenes.location: North gate of the vanishing mile
scenes.player_prompt: The worn milestone gives two distances at once. A bell rings once from behind fog.
essential_clues: Fresh boot tracks lead toward the ruined wayhouse.
An older track slips toward the broken milestone.
optional_clues: A lantern-wisp is drawn to exposed bell metal.

scenes.player_prompt: The reeds part around a dry line of stepping stones. Something large moves in the water.
essential_clues: The stepping stones lead to the unmarked milestone or tollhouse.
A handbell can be heard beneath the water.
optional_clues: Mire wolf den can be skirted without fighting.
Nessa Darr knows a safe boat route.

scenes.player_prompt: An unmarked stone stands in grass that seems to lean toward a sound you cannot hear.
essential_clues: The stone is a relay for the tollhouse bell; its grooves match the keeper's lever.
Inscription: 'A road is kept by those who return.'
optional_clues: The old relay may stabilize a new path but flood some reedland.
Elowen scratched twelve tally marks in the stone.

scenes.player_prompt: Someone has recently lit a lamp beneath the broken rafters. A survey cord is tied to the stairs.
essential_clues: Elowen is trapped in a resonance loop beneath the floor.
The bell may be silenced, renewed by a voluntary memory, or rerouted through the milestone.
A page of Elowen's notes records the phrase: 'A road is kept by those who return.'
optional_clues: Bell-Husk listens to a steady three-beat handbell rhythm.
A rusty lever operates the lower chamber striker.

scenes.player_prompt: Beneath the road hangs a dark bell too large for the room. Its keeper stands between you and a rusted lever.
essential_clues: Elowen is alive but tethered to the bell's memory-plate.
Three solutions exist: memory exchange, striker destruction, or relay redirection; retreat remains possible.
optional_clues: The Gaunt Toller cannot leave the entrance threshold.
The relay phrase calms the keeper long enough for a hearing.

scenes.player_prompt: The old road holds its length for another season. Something personally meaningful has been surrendered to keep it so.
essential_clues: Elowen returns; the bell has been charged by an expressly chosen memory.

scenes.player_prompt: The lost memories return and so does Elowen, but the old mile no longer answers any map.
essential_clues: The route is unstable; Reedwater boats become necessary.

scenes.player_prompt: The road settles on a new line through the reeds, and the memory toll ends—for now.
essential_clues: Elowen returns; part of the reed track is now underwater.

scenes.player_prompt: You return with what you learned but without freeing Elowen. The situation remains unresolved.
essential_clues: The mystery remains available for a second attempt.
